title: Secure Artificial Intelligence Act of 2024
last_action: Introduced and referred to the Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

summary: Would have created federal processes to track, analyze, and respond to artificial intelligence security and safety incidents, vulnerabilities, and risks.
committee_dynamics: The bipartisan proposal addressed the gap between AI vulnerability discovery and federal incident coordination, but it did not advance before the Congress ended.
